objective: 持续优化 EmbodiedForge 两个实际小时，保留既有工作，完成实现、回归、测量、持续验证和可审查证据。
changes: Executed-action metadata with at least 2048 native float64 elements avoids a float64 mask result for uniform activity: all-active casts directly to an independently owned float32 output; all-frozen allocates owned positive-zero float32 output.

Mixed masks, small batches, nonnative/mixed dtypes and subclasses retain the original where-then-cast path. Physics control input masking, clipping, reward computation and reset behavior remain unchanged.

183 new regression cases cover boundaries, zero signs, native/nonnative dtypes, layouts, ownership, later step/reset independence, subclass dispatch and strict floating-point diagnostics. A public benchmark CLI exposes activity fraction and separate metadata/full-step scopes.

performance_claims.primary: Measured transient allocation peaks for large uniform executed-action metadata; no propagation to total memory.
performance_claims.latency: All signed paired measurements retained, including small and mixed controls. Shared host timings and component gains are not general step/training speedups.
performance_claims.full_step: Complete camera-free step time and peaks are separately measured for Reach/Hold and all/mixed/frozen activity.

scope: Synthetic CPU reference environment and executed-action metadata. No GPU, process RSS bound or training-throughput inference.

figure.scope: Separate metadata/full-step peaks for all-active/all-frozen batches. Raw mixed and small controls retained.

persistence_control.interpretation: Isolated simulated ENOSPC; no inference about earlier unclassified interruptions.

rejected_prototype.interpretation: The first masked copyto prototype reduced component allocation but was slower, so it was rejected. Prototype measurements are separate from final-source performance proof.

inherited_diagnostics.interpretation: Prior MotionClips fingerprint, round-7 exit-120 persistence interruption and round-8 exit-143 process termination remain unclassified. Their original files are retained. This round changes only executed-action metadata and does not infer those historical causes from passing replays or isolated ENOSPC controls.

signal_followup: The NumPy 1.24 action cohort runs under its own parent strace restricted to SIGTERM. Final trace is preserved after actual reaping; it does not identify the earlier sender.
round_scope: Two actual wall-clock hours include analysis, implementation, measurements, regression, sustained validation and export. Cohort starts/durations are separate; parallel durations are never added.
evidence_selection: Raw reports, scripts, controls, inherited diagnostics, initial text files and final review files/figure. Initial binaries/old compressed archives excluded; original hashes for all snapshot files retained.
